title: Banana Sunflower Cinnamon Bites

ingredients.name: sunflower seed butter (dedicated nut-free facility)
ingredients.safetyNote: read the allergen statement — jarred seed and nut butters are commonly ground on shared lines, so buy a brand made in a dedicated nut-free facility

steps: Slice the bananas into thick rounds on Sunday, while they are at their best — use however many are ripe; four is a guide, not a requirement.
Sandwich pairs of rounds with a spoonful of sunflower seed butter.
Dust with the cinnamon, then press the chia and pumpkin seeds onto the edges.
Freeze on a lined tray for 1 hour, then move to a container.
storageNotes: Eat within a day if kept in the refrigerator, since cut banana browns quickly. Frozen they keep 2 weeks and are better that way — take them out 5 minutes before eating.
goldenRuleCallouts: No tree nut is used in this snack, but a jarred butter is a processed product on someone else's equipment: buy one made in a dedicated nut-free facility and read the allergen statement before it comes into the house.
Uses the ripe bananas already in the house before they turn — freezing is what buys the extra days.
